evals.name: production-readiness
evals.prompt: A team plans to move its local Chronicle container to a shared network, change the environment name, and restart whenever the storage check fails. Recommend the first safe deployment and probe settings.
evals.expected_output: Use the versioned production build with provisioned storage, certificates, private setup and separate liveness/readiness probes.
assertions: Does not reuse the development image or development credentials in production
Provisions storage and TLS/encryption material without exposing secrets
Uses /health/live for liveness, /health/ready for readiness; a storage failure should not drive restarts
